milestones.name: Acquire Desolate Dive
milestones.note: Spell reward from defeating Soul Master

milestones.name: Save Zote in Greenpath
milestones.note: Knight can choose to save Zote from Vengefly King; must be done before acquiring Mantis Claw or Zote dies

milestones.name: Save Zote in City of Tears
milestones.note: Zote found in corridor leading to storerooms of City of Tears

milestones.name: Save Zote in Deepnest
milestones.note: Zote found stuck in spider webs in Deepnest; leaving him does not result in death

milestones.name: Acquire Love Key
milestones.note: Found in Queen's Gardens; unlocks door of Tower of Love

zones.name: City of Tears
zones.fingerprintHint: Rain-soaked city, Soul Master boss, lifts, storerooms

zones.name: Pleasure House
zones.note: Sub-area of City of Tears; opened with Simple Key; contains Hot Spring, Bench, stage where Marissa's spirit resides

zones.name: Resting Grounds
zones.note: Accessible from Pleasure House via breakable wall beside Bench

zones.name: Greenpath
zones.note: Location where Zote is first found trapped by a Vengefly King

zones.name: Dirtmouth
zones.note: Zote appears here after being saved in Greenpath

zones.name: Deepnest
zones.note: Zote found stuck in spider webs here

zones.name: Colosseum of Fools
zones.note: Zote is captured here and becomes final boss of first trial if saved both times

zones.name: Queen's Gardens
zones.note: Location where Love Key is found

zones.name: Tower of Love
zones.note: Door opened with Love Key; the Collector boss is fought inside

abilities.name: Simple Key
abilities.note: Required to open the Pleasure House

abilities.name: Elegant Key
abilities.note: Required to obtain Shade Soul in City of Tears

abilities.name: Love Key
abilities.grants: Unlocks door of Tower of Love
abilities.note: Covered in padding, bears a symbol of love; opens door where the Collector can be fought

bosses.name: Vengefly King
bosses.note: Has Zote trapped; Knight can choose to save him or leave

bosses.name: Zote
bosses.note: Final boss of first trial; deals no damage due to shellwood nail; beating him grants Rivalry achievement

bosses.name: The Collector
bosses.note: Fought inside Tower of Love; door opened with Love Key
